title: Vandalism
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Darryl has started working in Philadelphia with Erin's help, while Pam discovers that her warehouse mural has been vandalized with inappropriate images. Pam, Dwight, and Nellie attempt to find the culprit, leading to confrontations with warehouse worker Frank, who refuses to apologize. Meanwhile, Angela expresses tension about Robert inviting Oscar to a party despite their marriage. Jim and Darryl navigate their new living and work arrangements in Philly, and Dwight enforces workplace discipline by punishing Clark. The episode ends with unresolved conflicts around the vandalism and interpersonal tensions among the characters.
